# Learn codebase: prime your agent by reading every source file in full

Curated by Skill Harbor — @thedotmack's learn-codebase skill from the claude-mem plugin: a deliberately simple "prime the codebase" routine for starting work on a new or unfamiliar project (or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase" or "get up to speed"). The instruction is one non-negotiable rule: systematically read EVERY SOURCE FILE IN FULL, no matter how many there are, paging large files with offset/limit chunks. A reviewer note frames the token cost honestly: it front-loads a cognitive cache to make development cheaper over the life of the project. Honest caveats: **this is an extremely lightweight skill — a single instruction page with no helper scripts, references or templates**; on large codebases it can burn a lot of tokens up front, and it won't skip generated or vendored code on its own. Apache-2.0. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
